name: astro-starlight-docs
title: Kestrel CLI — developer documentation
description: Documentation site for a fictional preview-environment CLI, built with Astro 5 and the Starlight docs theme. Static output in dist/ with a client-side Pagefind search index and a splash landing page.
persistence: none (static site; search index is static JSON/WASM under dist/pagefind/)
notes: Serve dist/ as static files. Routes are directories with index.html (trailing slash); no SPA fallback — unknown paths should return 404.html. The /pagefind/ directory must be served (it is generated only by `npm run build`, not by `astro dev`). Node >= 18.20.8; built with Node 22.
